The villagers of Morton Fendle are up in arms when they discover the local craft centre, which they had invested in, is in financial uncertainty. When the owner of an equestrian center is trampled by his own horse, Barnaby unravels a complex feud from the past.

Bill Carter, one of the founders of a New Age commune called the 'Lodge of the Golden Windhorse', dies after falling down the stairs and breaking his neck. Jeff Bowmaker runs a profitable business in Midsomer Magna, conducting spooky "ghost tours" at night, but the unpopular village librarian turns up dead.
A man is killed after the winner of an urban myth competition gains a cult following, and myth becomes reality
When a prize-winning violinist is killed and his Stradivarius stolen, Barnaby must sort through a myriad of suspects and motives to find the real killer.
An outcast who was acquitted of murder years previously, comes under suspicion when more murders take place.
A Wild West show comes to Ford Florey and a serial killer starts to eliminate villagers in "Western" ways over a parcel of disputed swampland.
DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are called in to investigate a possible death by poisoning.
Deaths follow the discovery of a valuable musical manuscript sold cheaply at an auction.
A scarecrow festival takes a grisly turn when dead bodies are found staged like the straw creations.
A trendy organic bakery in a restored mill is causing resentment among several villagers.
An amateur opera company is in the middle of rehearsals when a dead body is found in the theatre.
When the body of a young man is found in a WWII hangar full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. But the man was not alone – and he was hit on the head before he died.
Barnaby must step into the spiritual world of mediums, psychics, and occult followers to find a killer.
Barnaby sends Jones undercover into a New Age cult to investigate the disappearance of a young woman who entered an introduction course and then never left the movement.
